name: Henmi Io
source:
Hobbies: Collecting cute stuff (but it's a secret)
Skills: Operating on electronic equipment and machines
Likes: Delicious food, high-calorie and deep-fried food like donuts and cake, taking care of plants
Dislikes: Troublesome things, Kuze Hinata
